tagline: Procedural textures, live — tweak the recipe, watch it redraw.
description:
Upstream texgen.js is a library. This is an editor: stack XOR, sines, noise, checkers, twirls; combine with add, multiply, xor; tint each layer; download a PNG.

Name a recipe, keep it, close the app — it is still there. Share the GIF and the recipe travels with it. Presets from the original examples are one tap, including the classic XOR look.

Unofficial port of texgen.js by mrdoob. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
